newsitem.title: UK: UK set to announce pools deregulation plans.
newsitem.headline: UK set to announce pools deregulation plans.

text.p: The British government is expected to announce later on Tuesday its plans to free up the football pools firms to help them to compete with the National Lottery, government sources said.

They said Home Secretary Michael Howard will give a substantive answer to a question which appears on the parliamentary order paper asking for a statement on the outcome of consultations on deregulation of the industry.

There was media speculation late last year that the government would allow the pools companies to set up lottery-style terminals in shops and will allow them to accept bets on sports other than soccer.
One newspaper even suggested that pubs would be allowed to stock pools coupons allowing bets on upcoming matches, showing the games in their bars and paying out winners at the end.
Britain's three major pools operators are Littlewoods, Ladbroke Group Plc unit Vernons, and Zetters Group Plc. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
